title: BEACON `/.well-known/sustainability` report (draft-besleaga-green-sustainability-wellknown-05)
description: JSON Schema for the response served at GET /.well-known/sustainability. Faithful to the v05 Internet-Draft data model (RFC draft-besleaga-green-sustainability-wellknown-05, public spec; the document and its CDDL/JTD are the normative source). A successful response is EITHER a single sustainability-metrics object (Basic level) OR an array of them (extended `granularity` trends). BEACON publishes ESTIMATED / MODELED values only (measurement-method=third-party-modeled; methodology-uri -> docs/SUSTAINABILITY.md); see ADR-020. Per the draft, clients MUST tolerate unknown fields, so the object is open (additionalProperties allowed) to preserve forward compatibility (versioning/extensibility section of the draft). Aligns with GHG Protocol scopes, GSF Software Carbon Intensity (ISO/IEC 21031:2024), and CSRD/ESRS-E1 optional fields.

oneOf.description: Trend response (extended capabilities, e.g. ?period=2025&granularity=monthly). Per the draft's Array Size Limits security consideration, servers MUST cap the number of objects; 366 is RECOMMENDED.

energyUnit.description: Fixed literal energy unit (draft: MUST be one of Wh, kWh, MWh, GWh).

carbonUnit.description: Fixed literal carbon unit (draft: MUST be one of gCO2e, kgCO2e, mtCO2e).

sustainabilityMetrics.description: One sustainability report object for an origin (and optional target-path) over a reporting-period. Mandatory fields per the draft 'Mandatory Response Fields'; optional fields align with GHG Protocol / ESRS E1 / GSF SCI. Unknown fields are permitted (forward compatibility).

version.description: Schema version of the document, `major.minor` (e.g. '1.0', '1.1'). MUST be present and follow the versioning pattern.

updated.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the document was last updated (freshness anchor).

capabilities.description: Service level. MUST be 'basic' or 'extended'. 'extended' indicates support for the optional query parameters, not that all optional fields appear.

provider.description: Identity of the entity operating the origin and publishing the metadata (e.g. 'BEACON (sustain@beacon.local)').

measurement-method.description: Short description or reference to the methodology (e.g. hardware-metered, hardware-estimated, cloud-billing, third-party-modeled). BEACON publishes 'third-party-modeled' for the demo.

methodology-uri.description: Link to the full methodology specification (calculation methodology). For BEACON this resolves to docs/SUSTAINABILITY.md.

reporting-period.description: Timeframe covered by this object, RFC 3339 forms: YYYY | YYYY-MM | YYYY-MM-DD (Basic defaults to the most recently completed full calendar month).

energy-consumption.description: Total energy consumed by the host (or target resource) during the reporting period.

carbon-footprint.description: Total impact expressed in the carbon-unit (draft text: grams of CO2 equivalent; the unit is given by carbon-unit).

target-path.description: OPTIONAL. The resource path requested as `target` (e.g. '/api/v1/well-known/sustainability').

scope-2.description: OPTIONAL. Estimated Scope 2 (indirect / purchased-energy) carbon emissions.

sci-score.description: OPTIONAL. Software Carbon Intensity (SCI) score per GSF / ISO/IEC 21031:2024 = ((E*I)+M)/R.

functional-unit.description: OPTIONAL. If present, MUST be defined (e.g. 'per-request', 'per-user', 'per-thousand-requests') and SHOULD be documented in the methodology-uri document.

carbon-intensity-gCO2-per-kWh.description: OPTIONAL. Weighted grid carbon intensity in grams CO2 per kWh.

estimated-annual-emissions-kgCO2.description: OPTIONAL. Estimated annual emissions attributable to the origin (kg CO2e).

renewable-energy.description: OPTIONAL. Percentage of energy from sustainable renewable sources (0-100).

verifiable-attestation-uri.description: OPTIONAL. Link to a verifiable credential / attestation (anti-greenwashing). MUST NOT be treated by clients as proof of the metrics.

disclosure-uri.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.1+). Link to a machine-readable disclosure index for the origin (canonical example: a Green Web Foundation carbon.txt). A discovery link only; not proof of the metrics.
